Marketing Intern 
 You don't have to be a seasoned marketer to do an internship here. But if you have ideas, are good with words and have an eye for visuals, then you'll fit in perfectly with us. At Happy Feelings, you'll be part of the team, working on real events and learning how marketing really works in practice. So it's not your standard coffee-making internship, although we won't say no to a good espresso before a brainstorming session. 
 Creating moments that matter 
With around 100 events per year and over 100,000 visitors, we at Happy Group create musical memories that last a lifetime. No standard parties, but cheerful concepts that automatically put a smile on your face. And you can play a part in that. 
 About the job 
 DO YOU HAVE THE HAPPY APPROACH? 
We are looking for someone who knows how to get things done and how to tell a good story. A creative doer who gets energy from scrolling, posting, writing and switching gears. Is this something for you? - You are enrolled in a higher professional education or university programme in marketing, communication, media, or events - You write fluently and have a good sense of tone (and timing) - You have experience creating and editing social media content for TikTok & Instagram - You speak English well - You can work independently without getting lost - You stay cool when things get busy - You don't think twice about working at the weekend (especially if it's fun) - You enjoy attending our events to create content for social media 
 What you get in return 
 Why you want this 
 - An office in Amsterdam with a bar and drinks - A young team that not only works hard, but also laughs hard - Free admission to our events (you want to know what you're doing it for, right?)) - A lot of freedom, even more responsibility - The opportunity to make a real contribution 
 Ready to join the party? 
Send your CV and motivation letter to nic@happygroup.nl
